meta.title: Lídia Belas — Researcher · Digital Anthropology, Gender and Digital Cultures
meta.description: Lídia Belas — undergraduate in Social Sciences/UFBA, PIBIC researcher at LABHDUFBA. Research on online misogyny, digital games, gender and technology.
hero.subtitle: Early-career researcher · Digital Humanities · UFBA
hero.research: Online misogyny in digital games and gamer communities, from an anthropological approach.
about.label: About
about.bio1: I am an undergraduate student in Social Sciences at the Federal University of Bahia (UFBA), with a bachelor's degree in Anthropology. My research is situated in the field of Digital Anthropology, focusing on gender, technology, and online sociability.
about.bio2: I am a research fellow at UFBA's Digital Humanities Laboratory (LABHDUFBA), where I conduct PIBIC research.
about.bio3: My research agenda centers on online misogyny in games and gamer communities, investigated through an anthropological approach. I am interested in digital cultures and communities, the forms of sociability that emerge online, and the ways gender and technology intertwine in the everyday experience of platforms and games.
research.label: Research agenda
research.focus: My main focus currently is online misogyny in games and gamer communities, investigated through an anthropological approach that articulates research in digital environments and corpus exploration.
